text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- The International Finance Corporation (IFC) will continue to support Vietnam in the near future with consultation and human resources training in preparation for Vietnam's first stock exchange, IFC Executive Vice President Jannik Lindbaek said during an official visit to Hanoi.

-- Latvia's Foreign Minister, Valdis Birkavs, began a six-day official visit to Vietnam, where he held talks with his Vietnamese counterpart, Nguyen Manhh Cam. They signed an agreement on culture and science cooperation and a protocol on exchanging views.
-- The Governor of the State Bank of Vietnam licensed the country's first leasing firm.
-- The National Assembly's Legal Committee has said violations of the law and crimes have become more serious and there have been many shortcomings in the country's legal system.
-- More than 20,000 families in the central city of Hue are facing serious problems after flash flooding.
-- An agreement on establishing a resident mission of the International Finance Corporation in Vietnam was signed on Tuesday.
-- The Ministry of Cultural and Information has said it is reviewing policies to encourage art and cultural works.
-- Ho Chi Minh city has launched a third campaign to combat social evils ahead of the Lunar New Year festival.
